name: Kimberly Gonzalez
summary: 68-year-old woman with hypertension, type 2 diabetes, diabetic CKD G3a/A2, diabetic retinopathy and osteopenia. Built on an APEX Atlas synthetic record and enriched with imaging, reports, clinical notes, referrals, CARIN Blue Button claims and a care team.

notes: No address on the Patient resource (inherited from the APEX source). Insurance: Original Medicare since July 2018, before 65, as Medicare does for people entitled through disability (Part A and B, Medicare number in MBI format), a Medicare Part D drug plan and Medicaid managed care as a dual-eligible secondary payer, all on the CARIN Digital Insurance Card profiles with card images (the Medicare card is a sample layout, not the official design; plan names and numbers are synthetic).
